note: FTR_CREATE lands on screen 2000, FTR_EDIT on 1000; both expose the same FTR_ENTRY-* field names, so one model serves both. Element ids are SAP GUI Scripting paths and are NOT portable to another system - re-discover with sap_get_screen_elements before reusing.

transaction.label: Financial Transaction (deal number)
transaction.note: FTR_EDIT's deal number field. On FTR_CREATE it exists but is left empty.

classId.label: Security Class
classId.note: Only appears for securities-type product types (26B, ...). Added 2026-08-20 for TC-020, discovered live alongside the web lane's identical finding (probe-security-class.spec.ts) for 22B.

history.label: History
history.note: Read-only. This is the screen write_guarded() uses to ask SAP whether a settle actually landed after a COM drop - see session.py.
